proposedDocument.title: Governed action-decision round trip
proposedDocument.objective: Implement and prove one exact harmless read-only action from a constrained Moirae Code process through a fail-closed Horae loopback HTTP relay to Ananke authority and its immutable fixture, then return typed evidence while preserving identity, readiness, correlation, producer IDs, and route limitations.
nonGoals: No general filesystem, caller path, URI, or command capability.
No credentials, provider, browser, shell, child process, arbitrary IPC, workflow, persistence, retry, memory dependency, fallback, or external effect.
No direct Moirae-to-Ananke route and no fixture read by Horae, Moirae, Integration, or a helper.
No Runtime Contracts, package, or protocol version change.
No lock, compatibility set, checkpoint, completion, or sealing claim at activation.

repositoriesInvolved.name: fates-integration
repositoriesInvolved.role: evidence freeze, checkpoint gating, and real cross-runtime proof; no runtime implementation

repositoriesInvolved.name: ananke
repositoriesInvolved.role: sole action authority, immutable fixture owner, physical reader, and authoritative decision/outcome/audit producer

repositoriesInvolved.name: horae
repositoriesInvolved.role: sole fail-closed Moirae-to-Ananke relay, identity/readiness admission owner, and route-event producer

repositoriesInvolved.name: moirae-code
repositoriesInvolved.role: constrained action-only client host and typed result/limitation presenter

repositoriesInvolved.name: adrasteia
repositoriesInvolved.role: unchanged portable-contract baseline and review authority only; no implementation branch

repositoryOrder: Integration freezes expected evidence on codex/slice-002-cross-runtime-proof and publishes the Ananke handoff.
Ananke implements on codex/slice-002-bounded-read-implementation only after accepting the Integration freeze; its tagged checkpoint and handoff gate Horae.
Horae implements on codex/slice-002-governed-handoff-implementation only after accepting Ananke; its tagged checkpoint and handoff gate Moirae Code.
Moirae Code implements on codex/slice-002-constrained-host-implementation only after accepting Horae; its tagged checkpoint and handoff gate Integration proof.
Integration runs real three-process proof only against the three exact accepted artifacts.
requiredHandoffs: Final Integration evidence set to all owners
requiredConsumerTests: Ananke strict action, two-field schema, authority binding, one-read, digest, typed audit, and zero-read denial tests.
Horae identity, registration, compatibility, fresh-readiness, drift, dispatch, relay, timeout, indeterminate, correlation, producer-ID, and no-read tests.
Moirae exact-action host, no direct fallback/read, typed presentation, correlation/producer, attestation, and bypass-disclosure tests.
deferredWork: Workflow, persistence, retry, compensation, memory, and content preflight
Provider, browser, shell, credential, and general filesystem capabilities
Any Runtime Contracts, package, or protocol change
Compatibility lock advancement, completion, and sealing until later proof-backed decisions
stopConditions: Stop on baseline drift, dirty/unknown work, failed validation, unmerged design, withdrawn approval, or unresolved authority contradiction.
Stop if fixture/schema/attestation/timeout/acceptance evidence is not frozen.

Stop if the route requires direct Moirae-to-Ananke, non-Ananke fixture access, mock transport, sibling package shortcuts, caller paths, general authority, retry, persistence, workflow, provider, browser, shell, credentials, memory, or fallback.
Stop if a producer checkpoint is not clean, pushed, hosted-green, tagged, reproducible, owner-signed, and accepted by its consumer.
Suspend on any unauthorized/multiple read, identity/readiness failure, false success/retry, or hard-timeout failure that cannot be fixed without bypassing controls.

finalEvidence.acceptance: Not yet available. Activation begins ordered implementation; completion requires accepted real three-process evidence and a separate compatibility transaction.
limitations: No runtime route exists at activation.
The governance claim is limited to the controlled tested route.
Completion and sealing are separate later decisions.
